comments.text: Rewrite the quote as the CEO of Akaike Technologies who is happy to have won Analytics India Certification for Great Firm for Data Scientists, 'Before starting Akaike I was researcher and a data scientist myself. That helped me create a culture of learning and experimentation and taking bold steps and all the other good stuff which any good data scientist looks for. I created a company where I would like to work as a data scientist myself.'
